purpose: RAVQ, uncalibrated (no training of any parameter): QTIP rounding (the strongest A16 W2 host, same port, per-layer seeds and H_U as the A16 baselines) under a module-level bit budget derived from C1. C1 measurements on QTIP W2: the imagined future carries the main error channel (BF16-future swap removes 24-36% of first10 motor MSE on three hosts; W2 -> W3 on the video expert gives 71% of the A + lambda Z + beta K gain, mostly through Z + K), while upgrading all 30 action-expert blocks W2 -> W3 buys nothing (FLAQ module 1, 26070509: total -1.3e-5 of 1.9e-3; exactly 0 on Z / K). So bits move from the executing network (action-expert blocks) to the imagining network (video-expert blocks) at equal total bits. Video blocks are indistinguishable end to end (block benefit spread = sampling noise), so inside the video body the extra bits follow the standard rate-distortion rule on the layer proxy. Two protocol items that any WAM quantizer can use are given to the reference arms too: interface Linears in BF16 (action.io + video.head: stable top-2 of FLAQ module 1, 0.01% of the weights) and the timestep-only conditioning Linears as exact per-timestep output tables (tcond 26066073: inputs identical across contexts and seeds, 11 video / 10 action timesteps; outputs exact, fewer bits than W2).

sources.1: results/ravq/qtip_K1 (this job: QTIP with K = 1, same code, seed and H_U)
sources.4: results/ravq/qtip_K4 (this job: QTIP with K = 4, only the video-body layers the W3 allocation selects)

qtip_k1: the port's quantize_layer accepts K in 2..4 because the official CUDA kernels exist for those; the trellis, Viterbi, packing and decoding are generic in K (bitshift_codebook L=16, V=2, K*V bits per step). ravq_qtip.quantize_layer is the port's routine with K in 1..4 that also returns the packed codes (trellis, SU, SV, Wscale, LUT) for the calibrated stage; for K = 2 it must reproduce the port bit for bit (test_ravq.py)

modules.text: video_expert.text_embedding.0/.2, action_expert.text_embedding.0/.2: the family's base bits
modules.table_bits: per expert 16 x distinct timesteps x (out of time_embedding.2 + out of time_projection.1), the distinct timesteps from results/lowrank/tcond/input_check.json (26066073); booked on the expert's time_embedding.0, 0 on the other two; installed as the BF16 masters, whose outputs equal the table exactly

allocation.rule: budget = total bits of budget_of - total bits of the arm before upgrades; video-body layers enter greedily by density n_l (p_l(base) - p_l(up)) / (bits_l(up) - bits_l(base)) (the reduction of the weight-averaged H_U proxy per stored bit, the baselines' proxy_nmse_weighted), highest first, ties by index; a layer that does not fit is skipped and the scan goes on; the result never exceeds the budget
allocation.proxy: p_l(b) = tr(dW H_U dW^T) / tr(W H_U W^T) from the A16 baselines' stats (b = 2, 3); p_l(4) for selection only = p_l(3)^2 / p_l(2) (the layer's own W2 -> W3 ratio applied once more), the measured value is reported after quantization
allocation.bits: QTIP bits_total per layer (trellis K bits per padded weight + SU 16 n_p + SV 32 m_p); for K = 1 and K = 4 the port's storage_bits before quantization, checked against the quantized layer

evaluation: held-out 40x2 with the C1 swap (worker.Work.evaluate: first10 motor, future NMSE, gripper, the quantized reader on the BF16 teacher future); QTIP_U_W2 from results/heldout/QTIP_U_W2.json (26043905)

reading.protocol: QTIP_W2I / QTIP_U_W2 and QTIP_W3I / QTIP_W3 on held-out mixed loss, first10 motor RMSE, gripper RMSE: how much the interfaces + tables recover alone (the main table must give them to every host)
reading.action_floor: QTIP_A1W2I / QTIP_W2I and QTIP_A2W3I / QTIP_W3I: first10 motor RMSE with the BF16 future (swap, = the action expert's own error), first10 motor RMSE, gripper RMSE; future NMSE must be identical (the action expert cannot reach the future)
reading.ravq: RAVQU_Wb against QTIP_WbI at no more total bits
reading.go: per family: RAVQU future NMSE <= future_ratio_max x QTIP_WbI's and mixed loss <= mixed_ratio_max x QTIP_WbI's -> LIBERO-Plus closed loop of RAVQU_Wb paired against QTIP_WbI; QTIP_W2I's closed loop runs in any case (it resets the baseline table)

checks.k2_bitwise: on the cluster CPU test: ravq_qtip K = 2 equals the port's quantize_layer bit for bit
checks.decode: every K = 1 / K = 4 layer: the packed trellis decodes to the LDLQ output exactly (the port's VERIFY_DECODE)
checks.bits: every new layer's bits_total equals storage_bits(m, n, K)
checks.budget: every RAVQU arm's total bits <= its budget_of arm's
checks.future_identity: QTIP_A1W2I vs QTIP_W2I and QTIP_A2W3I vs QTIP_W3I held-out future NMSE equal (relative <= 1e-6)
